remark: Note 1) Under Common Details tab, parking is marked as per the approved drawing and calculation table and a stated logic that, all the vehicles that are fully covered (within outer most projection line on both sides) are marked as parked on stilt floor and any uncovered or semi-covered vehicle is marked as parked in open area including handicap parking. The visitors parking is provided over and above the parking provided and hence marked under open area. 2) The open area is mentioned as per the certificate issued by the architect which is attached under Documents Tab. 3) The promoter has provisioned the common amenity, gym and indoor game room at basement floor of the building and common terrace and common swimming pool at the terrace of the building, which being a facility is for the use of the residents of the building and not for sale. 4) The promoter has also provisioned for two private terrace which shall be available with unit 601 and 602 of the 6th floor which is duly marked under Apartment Wise Detail Tab. Kindly take a note.

For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub - section (2) of section 4, the construction cost shall be the total cost incurred by the promoter, towards the on - site expenditure for the physical development of the project and includes fees payable to the architects, consultants, project managers / staff including engineers, marketing agents etc. fees / charges / security deposit payable to various departments / authorities, Labor Cess, VAT which are incurred during the development of the project.

On-site expenditure for development of entire project excluding cost of construction as per (ii) above, i.e.
